verdict.rationale: Increase documents webhooks and Real-Time Decisions that call your own servers so you can act on events. These are developer building blocks for building your own automation, not a product-native way to define event-triggered rules. Nothing in the pack shows a built-in rule or automation engine where users configure triggers and actions in Increase itself, so the applicable axis earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
